route: Route A, Tokyo to Osaka through the Alps
calculator: NEXCO Drive Plaza highway toll and route search (driveplaza.com/dp/SearchQuick)
vehicle_class: Light vehicles, etc. (the site's own label for kei cars)
payment_columns: Regular price (cash), ETC tolls, ETC2.0 tolls, as shown by the site. Bobby will rent an ETC card with the car, so the ETC column applies.
leg_method: Each leg was searched between two expressway interchanges chosen to match the stops, on the date that leg falls on in the plan, departing 09:00. Interchanges are my assumptions, not a recorded drive. 'Route 1' is the first route the site lists. Roads for Route 1 were read from the site's route detail.
estimate_label: Estimate, computed by code from the site's figures. Not a quote.

fuel.reason: No official Wagon R fuel economy figure or official petrol price retrieved yet

estimate_yen.note: computed by tools/build_tolls.py from the legs below

not_included: Magome to Takayama on Mar 3, assumed to use free national roads (Routes 19 and 41) as drawn in the route plan; the site's expressway route for Nakatsugawa to Takayama Nishi is 3,530 yen ETC and 162.6 km, a long way round through the Nagoya side, and is NOT in the total
Kiso Valley day (Mar 2) and Takayama sightseeing: local roads, assumed no tolls
Local-road driving between stops (Yokohama to Kamakura, Hakone to Gotemba, Shiojiri to Narai, Takayama area, Lake Biwa shrine detour, Kyoto city driving)
Hakone toll roads (Hakone Turnpike and similar privately run roads), not priced by this site
problems: Legs use assumed interchanges. The Mar 3 Magome to Takayama day is set to zero tolls on an assumption (free national roads); this is not a site figure. The Lake Biwa shore route on Mar 5 uses free Route 161 for part of the way, so the real toll may be lower than the site's all-expressway figure. Kanazawa to Kyoto was searched as one leg to Kyoto Higashi, and Mar 6 starts at Kyoto Minami. Leg L2 starts at Fujisawa as a stand-in for Kamakura and ends at Odawara Nishi as a stand-in for Hakone. A flat-rate pass for foreign visitors has not been checked yet. Fuel not done.
